_about: William Ralston Shedden Ralston's (1828-1889) Russian folk tales, translated from Afanasyev's and other Russian collections, with his commentary: Russian Fairy Tales: A Choice Collection of Muscovite Folk-lore (New York, 1873), the American edition of his Russian Folk-Tales (London, 1873). Ralston is the translator, recorded in the title. Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain.

ralston-russian-fairy-tales: Russian Fairy Tales: A Choice Collection of Muscovite Folk-lore, tr. W. R. S. Ralston (1873)

_excluded.ralston-other-translations: Turgenev's Liza (PG 12194) and Schiefner's Tibetan Tales (PG 66870), both tr. Ralston: outside the relay's ask (Russian tales); Tibetan Tales would suit a later folk-tale batch
_excluded.ralston-commentary-only: Stokes's Indian Fairy Tales (PG 31209): Ralston wrote notes only
